name: vic-llm-opencode
description: Standalone LLM client module that drives the open-source OpenCode CLI (npm: opencode-ai) as a subprocess, pointed at any provider it natively supports — including z.ai's GLM Coding Plan — via a per-run generated opencode.json. Gives GLM (and any future OpenCode-supported provider) a real agentic coding capability without any dependency on the Claude Code CLI or a Python toolchain. Mirrors vic-llm-claude-code's ClaudeCodeAgentClient shape so vic-coding can use either interchangeably.
